## What’s New

ModShelf can now download Steam Workshop items on iPhone and keep them organised per game.

## Changes

- Library with per-game folders, search, tags, filters and favourites
- Update checks, file verification and ZIP export
- About screen with GitHub, bug reports, feature requests and an update checker
- LiveContainer-aware folder path and a new app icon

## Notes

Ad-hoc signed IPA. Use SideStore, AltStore, Feather, LiveContainer, TrollStore or similar to install it.
